title: ContextDesk ImportProfile v1
description: A portable, declarative, versioned import plan. Contains no executable code and no user-supplied regular expressions. A format profile reference expresses an expectation; it never activates a parser on its own.

minReaderVersion.description: Lowest reader version able to interpret this document. A reader that is older must refuse the document rather than partially understand it.

version.description: Monotonically increasing. Editing an import profile produces a new version whose digest differs; documents are never edited in place.

scope.description: Mandatory. A import profile never applies globally, so a correction cannot silently change behaviour for unrelated corpora.

safePattern.description: Bounded glob. '?' matches one non-separator character, '*' matches within one path segment, '**' matches whole segments. There is no alternation, no character class, and no quantifier, so matching is linear and cannot be made to backtrack catastrophically. Must be relative: no leading '/', no backslash, and no '.' or '..' segment.

profileRef.description: Reference to a profile the build already registers. A reference cannot define new parsing behaviour.

role.description: Matches the Incident Evidence Bundle manifest role vocabulary, plus 'unknown'.

formatProfile.description: Expected format. Reported as applied only where the source's own content fingerprint already agrees; otherwise the result is drift.

timestampPolicy.description: Reference to a timestamp/timezone policy the user already reviewed. Never encodes a timezone guess; an absent declaration stays unresolved.
